lines.say: At 2 PM, checkout broke. Every payment failed, and nobody had touched a single line of code.
lines.show: At 2 PM, checkout [broke.] Every payment [failed,] and nobody had touched a single line of code.

lines.say: The payment program had restarted on another server, with a new address. Your app was still calling the old one.
lines.show: The payment program had *restarted on another server,* with a new address. Your app was still calling [the old one.]

lines.say: Server addresses change all the time. Your app needs a way to find the current one.
lines.show: Server *addresses change* all the time. Your app needs a way to *find the current one.*

lines.say: Imagine contacts on your phone that update themselves whenever a friend's number changes. That's service discovery, for programs.
lines.show: Imagine *contacts* on your phone that update themselves whenever a friend's *number changes.* That's *service discovery,* for programs.

lines.say: One way is a directory that matches program names to their current addresses.
lines.show: One way is a *directory* that matches program *names* to their current addresses.

lines.say: When payments restart somewhere else, its entry updates. Your app looks payments up by name and gets the new address.
lines.show: When payments *restart* somewhere else, its *entry updates.* Your app looks payments up *by name* and gets the *new address.*

lines.say: If AI writes your code, follow for the system design it leaves out.
lines.show: If AI writes your code, *follow* for the system design it [leaves out.]
